title: Flow
intro: Up to three teams at a glance — the last {{days}} days of each figure, with an arrow against the {{days}} days before. By default the teams you manage come first, then the others by name; pick other teams below and this browser remembers them. Double-click a bar to list the items behind it; with the keyboard, Tab into a chart to reveal its figures. Each section title opens its full report for the same window.
empty: No data has been derived yet. The overview appears once a data source is connected and synced.
emptyAdmin: No data has been derived yet. Connect a data source, let it sync and check the metrics settings.
noTeams: No team exists yet, so there is nothing to compare. Teams are created by an administrator.

freshness.label: How fresh the data is
freshness.windows: Figures cover {{from}} – {{to}}; arrows compare with {{previousFrom}} – {{previousTo}} (days in {{zone}}).

view.QUALITY_EPICS_ESTIMATE_GAP: Epics whose estimate differs from their tasks

sprints.title: Last sprint
sprints.caption: Each team's last closed sprint, in man-days: capacity, initial and final scope against what it delivered (its velocity).
sprints.empty: No team has a closed sprint yet.
sprints.chartLabel: Chart: capacity, initial scope, final scope and delivered scope of each team's last closed sprint
sprints.tableLabel: Each team's last closed sprint, as a table

granularity.title: How big the work is
granularity.caption: Median of the tasks done {{from}} – {{to}}. A lower figure is better (smaller batches); the arrow compares with {{previousFrom}} – {{previousTo}}.

accuracy.title: How well estimates hold
accuracy.caption: Share of the tasks and epics done {{from}} – {{to}} whose actual landed within ±10, 25 and 50% of the estimate at start (PRED). A higher share is better; the arrow compares with {{previousFrom}} – {{previousTo}}.
accuracy.chartLabel: Chart: {{team}}, share of tasks and epics within ±10, 25 and 50% of their estimate
accuracy.tableLabel: {{team}}, accuracy of estimates, as a table

epics.title: Epics in progress
epics.caption: Epics started and not yet done, right now, and how long they have been going — age in working days since each started.

tasks.title: Tasks in progress
tasks.caption: Tasks started and not yet done (in progress, waiting or blocked), right now, and how long they have been going — age in working days since each started.

throughput.title: How much is delivered
throughput.caption: Tasks done {{from}} – {{to}}, week by week (man-days), and how long they took. Higher delivery and lower cycle time are better; arrows compare with {{previousFrom}} – {{previousTo}}. The first and last weeks may be partial.
throughput.tableLabel: {{team}}, delivery per week, as a table

quality.title: What is missing from the data
quality.caption: Counts of findings per team. Tasks are the ones done {{from}} – {{to}}; epics follow the Data quality report (open now or done in the window). Fewer is better; the arrow compares with {{previousFrom}} – {{previousTo}}. The estimate gap tolerance is {{percent}}%.
quality.epicsEstimateGap: Epics whose estimate differs from their tasks by over {{percent}}%

teams.label: Teams shown
teams.defaultHint: Default: the teams you manage, then the others by name
